findings.summary: The shared-closure decision walked the complete enclosing function once for every mutable declaration. The compiler now collects captured symbols once per function or source-file owner in a WeakMap, preserving the same symbol-based decision while avoiding quadratic repeated AST work.
The number/boolean/string eligibility rule for shared scalar cells was repeated in three emission paths. One local predicate now states that rule for initialized and uninitialized declarations alike.

The adjacent custom-shader and scene-shader Value fields had drifted between two- and four-space indentation. The touched interface block now follows the surrounding two-space layout without changing its types.

The node-particle billboard generator repeated the full BillboardSystemOptions aggregate but omitted the newly shared custom texture-name lane. It now initializes that lane explicitly like the other billboard producer, with a generator-level regression anchor.
